section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a single study examining the relationship between body image discrepancy and disordered eating in a sample of 369 women. The study investigates the distinct roles of cognitive fusion and body appreciation as mediating factors, while controlling for BMI. Results indicate that body image discrepancy predicts disordered eating, with this effect partially mediated by cognitive fusion and body appreciation.
